items.exactFeedback:
https://mindmake.co/ai-gtm - this page has the most confusing user experience. As I scroll, I just have no idea where to look. There's no visual hierarchy of sections. There are no scroll builds. It doesn't set up a universal problem that someone will really feel empathically that we understand them. None of this talks to a user one-to-one, so it doesn't really set up the problem that we're solving. The fonts are all over the place. They're not part of a cohesive design system as per the rest of the repository, nor is the rest of the look and feel of this page, to be honest. The content is more or less there in terms of what we're supposed to be saying and offering, but everything else is not up to scratch in terms of:

* the copywriting
* the UX
* the aesthetics
* the design system
* the build of the page
* the visual delight etc etc

items.element: "As I scroll, I just have no idea where to look. There's no visual hierarchy of sections."

items.acceptanceTest: At 1440x900 and 390x844, every scroll position shows exactly one chapter heading or pinned step in the primary position; no two bordered panels compete; no section eyebrow sits above a heading.
items.resolution: Rebuilt as full-screen chapters with one heading each, a mono step rail and no section eyebrows or competing bordered panels (quality/route-lock/approved-production-r47.json).
